learner_operation: Read the differential equation, identify h(x) and g(y), and select an equivalent separated equation (1/g(y))dy/dx=h(x). Counting repeated components in the answer bank can avoid identifying either factor from the ODE.

fixed_features.feature: One first derivative and separation only, with y-only derivative multiplier and x-only RHS.
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 6767 / 56fc1c96-3599-5022-8d83-60d4188ccf07 defines this form; canonical example ends at separation. No integration or initial conditions are assessed.

fixed_features.feature: Five equations in a single radio field and exactly one separated equivalent answer.
fixed_features.justification: All ten complete captured source banks have this response contract.

fixed_features.feature: Small positive coefficients, bounded integer powers, positive even-power radicals.
fixed_features.justification: Conservative same-method variations preserve local domains and easy algebraic workload. Sign coverage is not required as a quota; however no instructional rule requires the correct row to be uniquely free of minus signs in a recognizable bank.

answer_roles.role: Complete dependent factor and reciprocal multiplier
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary supported powers and direct versus inverse placement; source q-158022 has y as a numerator factor, q-158025 and q-158030 place it in the denominator. Derive every dependent display together.
answer_roles.observed: Across six easy templates both transfer directions occur. Revised quotient banks vary n=1..4 but repeat the correct n four times and the wrong n once; this leaks the answer-bearing assignment through answer-bank frequency.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary exponential base/scale, rational shifts and supported explicit factors independently of dependent powers.
answer_roles.observed: Prompt/solution/answer content follows supported parameter changes, but quotient-bank construction repeats h as RHS three times. Combined modal power and modal RHS identify the key without reading the ODE.

answer_roles.role: Correct row versus distractor roles and position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Shuffle choices and author plausible competing separated equations without a fixed count, sign, length or component-frequency signature of correctness. Exact observed banks may be reserved for source replay.
answer_roles.observed: Row positions vary. Both quotient profiles remain vulnerable to a modal-component cue. In the recognizable power/sign profile three rows share the correct LHS, and the shortest among those is always correct.

coverage.result: 10/10 prompts, complete choices, correct values and solutions match after harmless display normalization. Canonical radical has no captured answer bank.
Both profiles and all four quotient powers exercised for each quotient family, including exponential base/scale endpoints and prior exact witnesses. Modal strategy succeeds 18/18 quotient records.
Even powers 2/4 and coefficient endpoints 1/5 retain unique mathematical correctness; shared reciprocal-root candidates flip under a relevant change.
40 input records ->28 accepted; all six easy templates and both quotient profiles survive. All 24 raw and 18 accepted quotient instances admit the new cue.

5/5 survive actual delivery filtering. Its exponential quotient 4cc34a53-2d0e-5e5d-9f42-8f3c31da05f8 admits both the modal and shorter conditional cue. This does not assert one cue solves all five members.

counterfactuals.change: Hold other parameters/profile fixed; change simple_quotient n=1->2, exp_quotient n=1->2, and sqrt_quotient n=2->4.
counterfactuals.expected: ODE, reciprocal multiplier and explanation change together. A common displayed candidate must switch truth value when its dependent power changes from a distractor to the required power, or conversely.
counterfactuals.observed: All three pairs have shared candidate truth flips, correct answers update, all five choices per record pass native acceptance/rejection expectations, and actual UI screenshots 025..030 display the changes.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorial 6767 requires the reciprocal of the actual g(y), so changing its power must reconsider the selected equation. Source q-158025/q-158030/q-158026 supply these factor forms.

counterfactuals.change: Hold simple_quotient n=1 and quotient-power-sign profile; change seed 0->5 to shuffle choices.
counterfactuals.expected: The ODE, solution, complete mathematical bank and correct expression remain identical; order cannot determine native grading.
counterfactuals.observed: All content invariants preserved, order changes, native grader accepts the same expression in both records, and UI screenshots 031/032 retain identical mathematics.
counterfactuals.justification: Display position is absent from the lesson definition of separation and has no answer-bearing role.
